Chase Tone® Scripture Wah® Chase Tone® Gypsy Wah™ CHASE TONE® Script Wah™ CHASE TONE® Picture Wah™ Artists About Us Contact Us About Us Policies- US Veteran’s Discount, Shipping & Returns Chase Tone™ Premier Guitar Magazine Interview CHASE TONE® Secret Preamp™ REVIEW Amplifiers JTM45/100 Replica search Chase Tone™ Blue Stardust™ BC108 Silicon Fuzz Home » Chase Tone™ Blue Stardust™ BC108 Silicon Fuzz Sold Out!   CHECKOUT THE CHASE TONE™ ’68 Red Velvet FUZZ™ !   http://chasetone.com/chase-tone-68-red-velvet-fuzz/   Limited production.   ~ Chase Tone™ Blue Stardust™ BC108C Silicon Fuzz ~   “ For those who desire inspiring silicon fuzz: punchy blues leads, singing harmonically rich overdrive and glassy cleans ideal for Blues, Rock, Funk and Jazz. . .”   Imagine a complex, harmonically rich BC108 Silicon Fuzz with effortless sustain, touch dynamics balanced for old school Eric Johnson style to Jimi Hendrix’s Electric Ladyland! Superb shade of tones via guitar Volume & Tone settings. Ideal for improvisational playing with feeling via the Band of Gypsies!   Hi Kyle, Just received the Blue Stardust. Wonderful little box! Incredible! Like every time you do it perfect Tone is so rich and inspiring. Good looking, Good sounding! Thanks again, Vassili -Controls- Volume: Higher settings acts like an EQ producing more treble cut. Fuzz: Full range of travel. Backing off slightly from maximum increases feedback and reduces bright fizzy overtones on higher bias settings. Bias: Optimally biases the transistors for the preferred gate, feel and pick attack; from warm condensed fuzz tones to open punchy exploding blues leads with glassy over-driven cleans. Headroom: Reduce bottom end, enhance guitar volume cleanup, and reduce or eliminate wah induced oscillations (Guitar> Wah > Fuzz > Amp). The Blue Stardust arrived last night and I was able to spend a couple of hours with it. It sounds great! At full gain it is very aggressive, but it cleans up better than any other silicon fuzz I’ve played. The headroom knob totally rocks!!! Not only is it a great fuzz pedal, but at lower gain settings it’s an awesome OD pedal. I’m totally diggin’ it! Best regards, -Trent Another great pedal! Thanks Kyle! – Joe   As part of the Chase Tone Stardust Effects Pedal series with finishes inspired by a love for astronomy. High Quality Translucent Star Dust Powder Coat Finishes. (Zero Ozone Emissions) Futuristic Trapezoidal Design is Pedal Board and Gig Bag Friendly. (Perfect for late night jams or sitting in with a live band.) Rear Facing American Made Input & Output Jacks as well as standard polarity DC Jack. (Keeps cables out of the musician’s path.) Enclosure-mounted (with stop-lock-tab), PCB-mount Potentiometers soldered onto thick fiberglass circuit board with plated-through-holes for reliable performance on the road. Aged Value Carbon Film Resistors NOS Mustard Capacitor NOS Cherry Picked BC108 Silicon Transistors 360° viewing angle hi-brite RED Light Emitting Diode w/ red high-impact diffuse-ribbed ABS plastic protector.   I got the Blue stardust a few days ago… Man, it’s an amazing pedal. I really love how you can use it full vintage silicon fuzz vibe and more as a smooth drive tone. I need some more time with it but it’s a keeper and will get a permanent place on my pedalboard! next to the Red Stardust! Thanks man! -Steven   – Order Details- Normally $
- **Archive parent:** Blue Stardust BC108 Silicon Fuzz
- **Builder:** Chase Tone
- **Catalog type:** Fuzz
- **Identity:** High-gain silicon Fuzz Face-style fuzz using hand-picked BC108C transistors with external Bias and Headroom controls. [1][2]

- **VOLUME**
- **FUZZ**
- **BIAS**
- **HEADROOM** [1][2]

- Silicon Fuzz Face-style architecture.
- The expanded controls are Chase Tone's own adaptation of the vintage concept.

- **Special-ordered, hand-picked BC108C silicon transistors.** [1]

- Exact clipping-device part number is not publicly documented.

- **9V center-negative**. [1]

- No numbered electronic revision established.
- Blue Stardust translucent powder coat is cosmetic.

The Blue Stardust is voiced from glassy/clean-ish Fuzz Face response through singing overdrive and aggressive fuzz. Headroom can tighten the low end and reduce unwanted interaction with wah, while Bias changes the feel and saturation range. [1][2]

- **Identity:** High
- **BC108C:** High
- **Bias/Headroom architecture:** High
- **Exact diode:** Unknown

Chase Tone's official Blue Stardust page and Effects Database record agree on the BC108C device, four-control layout and expanded Headroom/Bias functions. [1][2]
